chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Seven nights a week at the Nest
summary: Zutty worked seven nights a week, slept all day, wore only a tuxedo, and he and Marge rarely got to a show or movie.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: And I didn't have nothing but a tuxedo and an extra suit because I........
Working two jobs AND I never did have on nothing but a tuxedo.
Yes. When you got up you were going to work?
Yes, because that last (Unintelligible 1) worked every night. He worked there every night. Seven nights a week. Yes sir. Yes sir, he worked there seven nights a week.
I wasn't thinking about buying any clothes.
Once in a blue moon we'd go downtown to a show in the afternoon. Once every four months we'd get to a show or a movie. Because he slept all day.
